js.yml:
on: [push, workflow_dispatch]
jobs:
  rust-stage:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/rust.yml
    secrets:
      CARGO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
rust.yml:
on:
  workflow_call:
    secrets:
      CRATES_TOKEN:
        required: false
      CRATES_IO_TOKEN:
        required: false
      CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN:
        required: false
      CARGO_TOKEN:
        required: false
jobs:
  release:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    environment: release-main
    steps:

      - name: Authenticate with crates.io (trusted publishing)
        uses: rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action@c6f97d42243bad5fab37ca0427f495c86d5b1a18 # v1.0.5
        id: prm_auth
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Publish start-command to crates.io
        run: node scripts/publish-to-crates.mjs
        env:
          CARGO_TOKEN: ${{ steps.prm_auth.outputs.token || secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN || secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.prm_auth.outputs.token || secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN || secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
